## Build 35 runtime Watchlist readback — November 2, 2026 (READ-ONLY, Agent 8 support)

**Direct authorized Supabase project metadata, not a source inference:**
- Production `wyyuqfdxucjksghsmhry`, ACTIVE_HEALTHY: `commerce-watch-refresh` **version 15**, status ACTIVE, `verify_jwt=false` (function implements its own dual bearer/worker-secret auth). `watchlist_worker_enabled` app_config JSON `enabled:true`, last changed **2026-10-12 19:58 UTC**.
- Staging `yzqjvdfgefveprobvvyw`, ACTIVE_HEALTHY: same function **version 23**, ACTIVE, `verify_jwt=false`. Flag **enabled:true**, last changed **2026-09-30 21:35 UTC**.
- Both project schemas include `user_device_push_tokens` and `watchlist_push_receipts`; no rows, push tokens, user IDs, or receipts were accessed.
- Both migration lists contain `20261029125521` but **do not list** `20261029184000` (Gemini permission), `20261031162813` (saved scan lifecycle) or `20261102125053` (restoration). These remain separate rollout gates; list readback does not establish deployed source parity.

**GitHub scheduler readback (default branch `master`):**
- The Production workflow has an active six-hour `schedule` declaration and protected `environment:production`. The current scheduled Production run [41475298925](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/actions/runs/41475298925) (Nov2 15:48 UTC) is **PENDING** with no job execution recorded; recent predecessor [41397158054](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/actions/runs/41397158054) and other recent Production scheduled runs were **CANCELLED** without jobs. Therefore **there is no verified successful Production sweep from these runs**, despite app_config enabled:true. Do not interpret the boolean as actual customer notifications or a successful worker invocation.
- The Staging workflow also has active six-hour schedule. Latest scheduled [41476247775](https://github.com/kscanaiapp/kscan-app/actions/runs/41476247775) succeeded on Nov2 15:54 UTC. Actual job log: `HTTP 200`, `{"mode":"sweep","enabled":true,"claimed":0}`. This verifies a configured Staging invocation but **zero watches claimed in that one run**, not the full worker/notification lifecycle.
- `docs/watchlist-tier2-operations.md` contains older September statements that scheduling is commented out and worker flag seeded false; current GitHub master workflow and direct flags supersede that historical description. Update stale operational documentation through the source owner, not by assuming prior defaults still hold.

**Disposition:** OBSERVED source/runtime/governance divergence; no confirmed incident, no validated Production sweep, no customer-device delivery test. Do not approve/launch the pending protected Production job merely to get green evidence. No flag/migration/deploy/schedule/secrets/customer-data changes performed. Current release audit remains INCOMPLETE.
